maria: quick bring-up notes: lamaX-8b q8 + speculative two-stage gives ~2x throughput (18->36 req/s) and p95 latency drop 220ms->130ms on A100, but codegen pass@1 -1.8%.
jon: any seed variance?
maria: ran 5 seeds, perf stable. sampler: stage1 beam k=4 early-abort 0.65, stage2 fallback.
kevin: quant shifts token ranks; try bias-correction.
maria: q8 + per-channel bias-corr improved code pass@1 to -0.6%. q8 without speculation is parity.
sophia: ops plan?
maria: propose: (1) route detected codegen to non-speculative profile (classifier PR>0.9), (2) relax early-abort threshold for q8, (3) run 10k holdout + 4k A/B shadow + token-level KL and top-1 swap.
beth: will collect failing unit-test snippets and heuristics for routing.
jon: I can allocate 2x A100s for a 24h canary if we sign off.
eval-bot: job queued q-98321.
ops-bot: canary blocked until safety checklist passes.
maria: will run ablation matrix: [8b q8 no-spec, q8 relaxed-spec, q6 spec] and post results within 48h.
